goal: First real rupee (M0) from a paid SevaaConnect consultation, then a repeat payer (M1), before any public deployment or ad spend.

steps.title: Experiment designed with numbers that can fail it
Outreach message, brief template and call checklist drafted by the cheap model
steps.how: aion plan apply incoming/plan-exp001-paid-consult.json && aion work --max 10

steps.title: Payment link created and the five unknowns answered
steps.you: Open the Razorpay dashboard, confirm live mode, create a payment link 'Design Clarity Call' for INR 2,499, and paste the link plus your answers to the five unknowns into PAYMENT_LINK.md (about 15 minutes).

steps.title: Message sent personally to 30 warm contacts within 3 days
steps.you: Send outreach_message.md one-to-one to 30 people who fit the buyer, and add one row per person to contacts.csv using codes C01-C30 (never a name or number).

steps.title: First rupee recorded with a Razorpay payment id (M0)
steps.you: When a payment lands, record it the same day: aion money-add revenue 2499 --stage ACTUAL --description "EXP-001 payer C07" --evidence razorpay:pay_XXXX. Then hold the call within 5 days and send the brief within 48 hours.
steps.how: aion money-add ... then aion experiment EXP-001

steps.title: Verdict reached by the rules (3 paid = success)
Only after SUCCESS: open the public funnel (T100, the founder gate)
steps.you: Authorise the Railway trial, set the four env vars there, choose the privacy mailbox, name the first lawful traffic source, and on the PC run aion secrets set for SEVAA_AUTOMATION_TOKEN, SEVAA_FOUNDER_TOKEN and SEVAA_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

steps.title: Repeat payer: the same code pays a second time (M1)
steps.how: EXP-002 (written by the cheap model after the verdict): consult -> first project stage
